about.sexNote: Used only to estimate your metabolism.

target.title: Your target
target.belowCurrent: Pick a weight below your current one.
target.aboveCurrent: Pick a weight above your current one.

fastHint.gain: 0.4 kg a week · some fat gain

health.title: Anything we should know?
health.pregnantHint: No calorie deficit will be applied
health.breastfeedingHint: No deficit, plus about 330 kcal a day

plan.title: Your daily plan
plan.caption: calories a day
plan.footnote: AI estimates can be off by 20–40%. Adjust portions for accuracy.
plan.weeks: About {{weeks}} weeks to reach {{target}} kg at this pace.
plan.sleepTip: Short sleep can increase hunger. Aim for 7 hours or more.
plan.pregnantNote: No calorie deficit is applied while pregnant or breastfeeding. Ask your doctor or midwife about your needs.
plan.conditionNote: This is a general estimate. Check it with your doctor or dietitian.

camera.title: Allow camera access
camera.body: Bites uses your camera to scan your meals. Allow it once now so it doesn't ask in the middle of a scan.

tip.ios: To stop Safari asking every time: tap aA in the address bar, then Website Settings, then set Camera to Allow.
tip.android: Choose Allow, and your browser remembers it.
tip.other: Choose Allow, and your browser remembers it.

camera.blockedBody: You can still add meals from photos or by typing, or turn the camera on and come back.

fix.ios: Tap aA in Safari's address bar, then Website Settings, then set Camera to Allow. Reload the page afterwards.
fix.android: Tap the lock icon next to the address, then Permissions, then allow Camera.
fix.other: Open your browser's site settings for this page and allow Camera.

install.title: Add Bites to your home screen
install.bodyAndroid: Open it like any other app, full screen and always one tap away.
install.bodyIos: Open it like any other app, full screen and always one tap away. It only takes three taps.

android.menu: Tap the menu in your browser
android.add: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen

ios.share: Tap the Share button in Safari
ios.add: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen
ios.confirm: Tap Add, then open Bites from your home screen

scan.scaleHint: Include a fork or your hand for scale.
scan.freeSlow: On the free plan this can take 10–20 seconds
scan.describePlaceholder: Describe your meal, e.g. two eggs and toast

denied.title: Camera unavailable
denied.body: Allow camera access in your browser, or pick another way to add your meal.

result.notFoodBody: Try again with your meal in the frame.

history.title: History
history.empty: Your scans will show up here.

activity.title: Activity
activity.noData: No Health data for this day.

settings.title: Settings
settings.codeLimited: Too many attempts. Try again tomorrow.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: All your meals and your profile will be removed. This can't be undone.
settings.disclaimer: AI estimates can be off by 20–40%. Adjust portions for accuracy. Bites is not medical advice.

errors.loadBody: Check your connection and try again.
errors.rate_limited: You've used all your scans for today. They reset tomorrow.
errors.not_food: That doesn't look like food. Try again.
errors.refusal: The AI couldn't analyze this image. Try another photo.
errors.bad_output: Something went wrong reading the result. Try again.
errors.upstream: The AI service is having a moment. Try again shortly.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Reload the app.
errors.bad_request: We couldn't send that. Try a different photo.
errors.camera_denied: Camera access was denied. Choose a photo or type your meal instead.
